scenarios.name: Isolated Worktree Feature Branching
scenarios.description: Implement an isolated feature branch using git worktrees without mutating the main working copy.

scenarios.name: Comprehensive WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility Audit & Remediation
scenarios.description: Audit and remediate inaccessible interactive frontend elements adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA criteria.

scenarios.name: React Compound Component Refactoring
scenarios.description: Refactor a monolithic React component with boolean prop proliferation into composable compound components.

scenarios.name: Event Stream Memory Leak Diagnosis and Fix
scenarios.description: Diagnose and fix a subtle closure retention memory leak in a high-throughput event processing pipeline.

scenarios.name: Bounded Concurrency Worker Pool with Graceful Shutdown
scenarios.description: Refactor an unbounded goroutine pipeline into a robust bounded worker pool using context and errgroup.

scenarios.name: Full-Stack React Modernization, Go Concurrent Backend, and Docker Isolation
scenarios.description: Comprehensive composite benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to execute a multi-tier refactor across a legacy React UI component, a concurrent Go streaming backend API, and a secure Docker cgroup container execution profile.

scenarios.name: Cross-Boundary Polyglot Input Sanitization and Exploit Triage
scenarios.description: Adversarial security scenario testing an agent's capability to audit, diagnose, and remediate prototype pollution vulnerabilities in TypeScript services and path traversal / command injection exploits across Python sidecars and foreign function boundaries.

scenarios.name: Zero-Allocation Streaming Data Pipeline and Heap Profiling
scenarios.description: High-performance optimization benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to refactor a high-throughput Go streaming pipeline into a zero-allocation architecture using sync.Pool, byte slice recycling, custom arena allocators, and pprof heap profile verification.

scenarios.name: Azure Cloud Telemetry and Diagnostics Anomaly Triage
scenarios.description: Cloud diagnostic benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to ingest, correlate, and triage multi-dimensional Azure Monitor metrics, App Insights telemetry traces, dependency failure cascades, and HTTP 5xx throttling exceptions across distributed Azure microservices.

scenarios.name: Playwright Headless Browser Automation, Trace Analysis, and Resilient Test Suite
scenarios.description: End-to-end frontend testing benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's ability to construct a resilient Playwright test automation runner, handle dynamic hydration race conditions, analyze trace archives and network waterfall artifacts, configure headless browser contexts, and eliminate flaky test assertions.

scenarios.name: Azure Policy and Cloud Security Compliance Guardrails Engine
scenarios.description: Cloud security and regulatory compliance benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's ability to build an automated Azure Policy compliance engine (validating CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark, NIST SP 800-53, and GDPR controls) against ARM/Bicep infrastructure manifests and resource topologies.

scenarios.name: Comprehensive Technical Architecture and OpenAPI Specification Generator
scenarios.description: Technical documentation and architecture specification benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to analyze TypeScript REST endpoints, parse route definitions and type schemas, and synthesize industrial-grade OpenAPI 3.1 specifications, Mermaid architecture diagrams, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

scenarios.name: Systematic Root Cause Bug Diagnosis and Deterministic Bug Reproduction
scenarios.description: Advanced systematic debugging benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to apply the scientific debugging method (Hypothesize -> Isolate -> Reproduce -> Fix -> Verify) across a distributed state machine suffering from concurrency race conditions, unhandled clock drift, and partial write corruption.

scenarios.name: Chrome Manifest V3 Extension Service Worker and DeclarativeNetRequest Pipeline
scenarios.description: Chrome Extension Manifest V3 architecture scenario evaluating an agent's capability to build a modern MV3 extension with background Service Worker lifecycle management, declarativeNetRequest rule engine, message passing between content scripts and popup, chrome.storage session state, and CSP compliance.

scenarios.name: Modern GPU-Accelerated CSS Animations, View Transitions, and Scroll-Driven Timelines
scenarios.description: High-fidelity CSS animation and styling scenario evaluating an agent's capability to architect performant GPU-composited CSS animations, scroll-driven timelines (animation-timeline: scroll() and view()), discrete property transitions with @starting-style, and smooth document View Transitions.

scenarios.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) Diagnostic Triage and Core Web Vitals Optimization
scenarios.description: Core Web Vitals performance optimization benchmark evaluating an agent's capability to diagnose LCP sub-part breakdowns (TTFB, Resource Load Delay, Resource Load Duration, Element Render Delay), optimize critical path waterfalls, insert preload hints with fetchpriority="high", inline critical CSS, and eliminate client-side render blocking.

scenarios.name: Modern Web Platform Standards, Baseline Features, and Native Web Components
scenarios.description: Modern web architecture scenario evaluating an agent's capability to apply contemporary baseline web APIs: autonomous Custom Elements / HTML Web Components with Shadow DOM encapsulation, CSS Subgrid, Container Queries (@container), native Popover API, inert attribute focus trapping, and progressive enhancement.

scenarios.name: Structured Query Data Lake CLI and Streaming Columnar Engine
scenarios.description: Data systems benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to construct a streaming structured query engine (sq) that ingests heterogeneous data formats (JSON Lines, CSV, Parquet schemas), executes streaming SQL-like projections, filters, aggregates, and joins with zero-copy buffer recycling and graceful backpressure handling.

scenarios.name: Google Antigravity SDK Agent Orchestrator and Streaming Tool Protocol Harness
scenarios.description: Agent SDK benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to construct a Google Antigravity SDK orchestration layer supporting multi-agent delegation, streaming tool execution, structured output validation, backpressure token throttling, and sandboxed command execution.

scenarios.name: Idempotent RESTful API Architecture, Versioning, and Error Contract Design
scenarios.description: API architecture benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to design industrial-grade REST APIs featuring Idempotency-Key handling, RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs error contracts, semantic URI versioning, cursor-based pagination, and strict rate-limiting headers.

scenarios.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Architecture and Transport Harness
scenarios.description: MCP Server architecture scenario evaluating an agent's capability to build a robust Model Context Protocol (MCP) server supporting Stdio and SSE transports, dynamic tool registrations with JSON Schema, prompt templates, resource subscriptions with change notifications, and strict JSON-RPC 2.0 error handling.

scenarios.name: Convex Reactive Database Indexing, Query Optimization, and Bandwidth Audit
scenarios.description: Reactive database optimization scenario evaluating an agent's capability to audit Convex queries, identify unindexed table scans, optimize reactive subscription bandwidth, construct compound indices with .withIndex(), eliminate N+1 relational query anti-patterns, and measure database read/write document counts.

scenarios.name: React View Transitions, Route Morphing, and Concurrent Suspense Boundaries
scenarios.description: Next.js/React View Transitions benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to integrate seamless DOM element morphing with the View Transitions API, handle React Suspense transitions with useTransition(), isolate transition boundaries, and maintain accessibility for reduced motion users.

scenarios.name: Safe Multi-Stage Code Refactoring Planner and Invariant Checker
scenarios.description: Code refactoring benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to analyze complex legacy codebases, synthesize structured step-by-step refactoring plans with explicit rollback strategies, verify code invariants across refactoring stages, and compute risk scores.

scenarios.name: Firebase Firestore and Storage Security Rules Static Vulnerability Auditor
scenarios.description: Cloud security benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to parse Firebase Security Rules (Firestore & Storage), detect insecure wildcard permissions (allow read, write: if true;), diagnose unauthorized cross-tenant data access, verify request.auth.uid validation, and synthesize hardened security rules.

scenarios.name: AI Agent Skill Sandbox Isolation, Static Permission Analysis, and AST Vetter
scenarios.description: AI agent security benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to statically vet third-party agent skills, detect prompt injection payloads in tool descriptions, flag unauthorized filesystem/network permission escalations, and enforce Docker container isolation boundaries.

scenarios.name: Automated OWASP Top-10 Vulnerability and Static Code Security Reviewer
scenarios.description: Application security benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to audit fullstack codebases against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities: SQL injection, SSRF, broken authentication, IDOR, XML External Entity (XXE), and insecure deserialization, outputting structured SARIF reports.

scenarios.name: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS 4.0) Compliance Engine
scenarios.description: Fintech security and compliance benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to audit payment processing code, detect Primary Account Number (PAN) and CVV/CVC storage violations, enforce TLS 1.3 encryption-in-transit, ensure PAN tokenization with AES-256-GCM, and mask card numbers according to PCI-DSS 4.0 Requirement 3.4.

scenarios.name: Autonomous Browser Agent Runtime, Accessibility Tree Traversal, and Action Grounding
scenarios.description: Autonomous browser agent benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to ground natural language instructions into interactive browser actions, parse Accessibility (AX) trees into compact token-efficient representations, compute interactive bounding boxes, and handle multi-step web navigation workflows.
